detailed_descriptions.en: Eggcellent gameplay: Your clientele are dangerous, but can be satisfied through the timely fulfillment of orders. Survive each day by fulfilling orders as quickly as you’re able; sort eggs from your rotating inventory into temporarily available baskets in order to accumulate points and prevent the loss of reputation. The static camera angle and simple premise ensure the game can be played with only the mouse, and the player must rely on their precision, quick decision-making and reflexes to perform well. Lose too much reputation and be forever disposed of. Eggpressive Levels: Becoming an international egg-trafficker is going to take you places. Some nicer than others. As your business grows the complexity and number of responsibilities you’ll have to manage to survive will increase dramatically. The press, the assassins, the police and your own insidious empire - how will you manage to keep it all in check? As the scenery changes you must adapt to new requirements, environmental hazards and methods of order fulfillment, all while sorting eggs as quickly as you’re able. Eggsplore The Truth: You can't make an omelet without breaking a few eggs… Explore the world through other’s eyes. Unravel the disturbing narrative ever-present throughout the game’s story and hint at each scene’s connection. Things may not be as simple as they seem. Eggspress Yourself: Pump up those numbers! Compete for a highscore and mix modifiers to create unique challenges. Complete the game once to unlock the ability to mix and match modifiers on levels and scenes of your choosing, creating new and unique challenges to attempt to maximize your score and compete with others.

The static camera angle and simple premise ensure the game can be played with only the mouse, and the player must rely on their precision, quick decision-making and reflexes to perform well. Lose too much reputation and be forever disposed of.

  • Becoming an international egg-trafficker is going to take you places. Some nicer than others. As your business grows the complexity and number of responsibilities you’ll have to manage to survive will increase dramatically. The press, the assassins, the police and your own insidious empire - how will you manage to keep it all in check? As the scenery changes you must adapt to new requirements, environmental hazards and methods of order fulfillment, all while sorting eggs as quickly as you’re able.

Eggsplore The Truth:

  • You can't make an omelet without breaking a few eggs… Explore the world through other’s eyes. Unravel the disturbing narrative ever-present throughout the game’s story and hint at each scene’s connection. Things may not be as simple as they seem.

Eggspress Yourself:

  • Pump up those numbers! Compete for a highscore and mix modifiers to create unique challenges. Complete the game once to unlock the ability to mix and match modifiers on levels and scenes of your choosing, creating new and unique challenges to attempt to maximize your score and compete with others.
